accueil.attente: The app for the day is being written. You will receive the link together with the invitation.
accueil.a_faire_rien: All that is left is to come.
accueil.film_attente: The film will be added here. It needs a connection: it is not kept offline.
accueil.periode_jour: The day is under way. This screen arrives with the wedding-day version.
accueil.periode_apres: Thank you. This screen arrives with the after version.

design.intro: Internal validation page. It is not intended for guests.
design.note_couleurs: The five colours never carry text. This is an art-direction decision: the measurements below show it does not follow from contrast alone.
design.mouvement_note: Fades and slides of 12 px at most, a single easing curve, 300 to 900 ms.

lancement.ecran3_texte: The schedule, how to get there, your reply. Nothing to install, no account to create.

retrouver.intro: The six-character code is printed under the QR code on your invitation.
retrouver.echec: We cannot find this invitation. Please check the code, or call us.
retrouver.trop_essais: Too many attempts. Please try again in an hour, or call us.

partager.intro: This link opens your invitation on another phone. It is also how you ask someone close to reply for you.
partager.non_reconnu: Please open your invitation from the QR code on your invitation card first.

erreurs.invitation_inconnue: This invitation is no longer valid.
erreurs.base_indisponible: The information will be here shortly. Please try again in a moment.

programme.intro: Five moments, from morning to night.
programme.detail_absent: The detail will be written here before the invitations are sent.
programme.agenda_journee: Until the times are set, the file adds the whole day of 3 June 2028.

infos.attente: This information will be written here before the invitations are sent.

faq.aucun_resultat: No question matches. Try another word, or call us.
faq.reponse_attendue: The answer will be written here before the invitations are sent.

reponse.question: Will you be with us?
reponse.enregistre_peutetre: Noted. We will remind you once, gently.
reponse.enregistre_non: We will miss you. We will be thinking of you.
reponse.non_suite: If you would like to leave a word for the couple, it is below. Nothing is required.
reponse.verrouille: The deadline has passed: your reply can no longer be changed here. Write to us and we will do it.
reponse.detail_titre: Who is coming, and to which moments
reponse.menu_attente: Menu choices will be added here before the deadline.
reponse.allergies_consentement: I agree that these allergies may be stored and passed to the caterer.
reponse.allergies_explication: An allergy is health data. Without your agreement we do not store it. It is visible only to the couple and the caterer, and is deleted 30 days after the wedding.
reponse.non_reconnu: Open your invitation from the QR code on your invitation card to reply.
reponse.erreur: We could not save. Please try again in a moment.
reponse.facultatif_ouvrir: Add a word, a song, where you stay

admin.refus: This area requires a valid access link.
admin.refus_detail: Access links are single-use and valid for 30 minutes. Generate a new one from the server.
admin.aucun_foyer: No household yet. Import a file to start.
admin.import_format: A semicolon-separated CSV file: foyer;invites;langue. Names within a household are separated by a vertical bar.
admin.import_bouton: Import and download the QR sheet
admin.import_avertissement: Importing generates the QR codes and backup codes, and downloads the printable sheet straight away. These codes are not stored in clear: keep the PDF.
admin.planche_avertissement: Regenerating replaces every QR code and backup code. Sheets already printed stop working. Only do this before the invitations are sent.
admin.domaine_absent: The domain is not bought yet: the sheet will use the server address.
